title: Jorjani's Persian grandmother talking to his long-dead grandfather while dying

tellings.quote: grandmother. And when she was dying, this exact thing happened. She starts talking to my dead grandfather.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells podcast host Jesse Michels that when his Persian grandmother was dying, she began talking to his grandfather, who had been dead for a long time. He says it was the same thing he had seen happen with another dying relative. If true, it would suggest some kind of contact with the dead at the end of life.
